title: OEM quotation desk
intro: Open a customer’s quote request, or enter the details from their email or message. Check the quantities and add your prices to prepare the quotation.
open: Open a quote request or saved quotation
local: Your work stays in this tab. Download the editable quotation before you close it.
noscript: Enable JavaScript to calculate prices and prepare a quotation.
name: Contact name
docHint: This sets the language of the quotation and email draft. Write your own item descriptions and terms in the customer’s language.
itemsHint: Enter unit prices in Thai baht (THB). Add separate items for design, samples or delivery as needed.
sendHint: Save the quotation as a PDF, then attach it to the email draft or send it through the channel your customer prefers.
revisionHint: Before changing a quotation you’ve sent, create a revision. The previous version stays in the history with its prices and terms.
dateError: Enter a quotation date. The expiry date must be on or after the quotation date.
priceError: Check the quantities, prices, discount and tax rate. Quantities must be greater than zero, the discount cannot exceed the subtotal, and the tax rate must be between 0% and 100%.
headerError: Enter the quotation number and either a contact name or a brand or company name.
invalidFile: We couldn’t open that file. Choose a quote request or editable quotation downloaded from this site as a JSON file.
saved: Your editable quotation is ready to download.
replace: Replace the work in this tab with the contents of this file?
max: This quotation has reached its limit for items or revisions.
newDone: The previous quotation is in the revision history. You can now edit the new revision.
draftBody: I’ve attached our quotation based on your request. If you’d like to discuss the quantities, packaging or delivery date, please reply to this email.
